text:
tara: Quick flag — spun up verdant13b (fp16 -> int8) candidate on staging. Significant unit savings but we're seeing a reproducible coverage/regression on multi-step synthesis. Need a concise scorecard + routing recommendation for GTN/PM.

vijay: paste the smoke numbers when you have them.

tara: smoke snippet:
```
fp16 baseline: cost_per_token = $0.0112, p95 = 152ms, baseline_accept = 0.80
int8 candidate: cost_per_token = $0.0032, p95 = 170ms, accept = 0.69
delta token cost ~= 3.5x reduction
long_recall (6k slice) = -10.8pp, short_recall (256) = -2.0pp
kv-cache hit ~79% on sampled trace
```

hana: That's a material longform drop. Failure mode? omitted bullets, missed conditions, truncated chains?

tara: Mostly omitted steps and partial enumerations on procedural prompts. Hallucination small (+0.4pp). Short prompts mostly fine. Prompt-boosting recovers ~2pp in some cases.

vijay: Try hybrid where attention + layernorm run fp16 and matmuls int8. Microbench: recovered ~5.6pp long_recall, cost +18% vs pure int8 (still ~2.9x cheaper than fp16). p95 +6-10ms.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary verdant13b-int8 starting us-west-2 (1 GPU). dashboard: https://internal/dash/models/verdant13b/canary

tara: Kicked off 350-sample labeled eval (synthesis + meeting slices). ETA ~5h.

hana: For GTN include a simple ROI / break-even table: avg_tokens = [300, 800, 1400] -> savings per request. Also include required conversion drop to wipe savings given an LTV assumption.

vijay: quick calc example (avg_tokens=800):
```
fp16_pp = 0.0112
int8_pp = 0.0032
savings_per_req = (fp16_pp - int8_pp) * 800 = $6.40
```

hana: If a quality hit causes a 3% conversion drop on critical flows with avg LTV $25, lost_rev = 0.03*25 = $0.75 per req, which is < savings here. But product needs precise sensitivity.

ops-bot: eval job finished (350 samples) -> https://internal/evals/verdant13b/350

tara: TL;DR from quick eval: int8 long_recall = -9.9pp, hallucination +0.5pp, accept_drop = 4.5pp. hybrid variant: long_recall = -4.3pp, hallucination +0.3pp, accept_drop = 1.6pp. p95 deltas small.

vijay: Proposed routing: default hybrid for mid/long outputs (>600 tokens), pure int8 for ephemeral/drafts and internal tooling, fp16 pinned for "final export" and high-value customers. Add token-estimate + intent flags.

hana: Rollout gates suggestion: require long_recall >= -7pp AND accept_drop <= 3pp on 24h rolling window to promote beyond canary. Auto-rollback if accept_drop >4pp on flagged slices over 12h.

tara: I'll draft a one-page scorecard with cost sims, per-variant metrics, sample failure CSV, and a short prompt-fix matrix (we saw a few cases fixed by adding a clarifying instruct).

vijay: Also add A/B plan: 2k-sample labeled A/B on production slices before reallocation >25%. Prepare conversion-sensitivity table for GTN/PM.

hana: ops ask: add rolling labeled-slice checks and a priming-sensitivity metric (fraction of failures fixed by tiny prompt tweak). Include monitor hooks and alert thresholds.

ops-bot: ticket INF-5022 created to track canary, eval artifacts, scorecard, and A/B plan.

tara: Quick note to GTN/PM: 350-sample is noisy; hybrid looks like a pragmatic compromise (much lower cost than fp16, noticeably better quality than pure int8). Recommend soft roll: hybrid -> 20-30% of synthesis traffic, fp16 pinned for final outputs, int8 kept for low-risk paths. Monitor conversion proxy and acceptability.

vijay: LGTM. I'll prepare the routing flags and cost-sim spreadsheet.

hana: will draft the GTN brief and include break-even and sensitivity scenarios. Tagging PMs now. :spiral_notepad:

tara: will upload scorecard and sample failures to INF-5022 later today. (small caveat: quick eval noisy; need larger A/B for decisive signal)
